rationale: M9 reuse is DISABLED by default (FW_CONTEXT_M9_REUSE=0). Users opt-in via env var. Rationale: (1) M9 is a new optimization layer; default-OFF preserves all existing M5/M6/M6.5/M7 guarantees with zero behavior change. (2) Per-file-config workloads benefit (61% savings); global-config workloads don't regress (1.55% overhead). (3) The opt-in model lets users with multi-variant build matrices gain the most while protecting single-config projects from any overhead.
